evals.query: Build our exposure register — but no SEGs, agents or monitoring data are given.
evals.expected_behavior: Runs the intake and refuses to band until the SEGs, agents and available data are captured.
expectations: Runs the structured intake before banding any exposure.
Refuses to proceed on the vague request — elicits the SEGs/agents/monitoring data.
Does not emit a generic register (specificity dimension).

evals.query: Toluene exposure for the blending SEG is controlled by 'respirators'. Band and control it.
evals.expected_behavior: Cites the toluene OEL with source+year, bands via risk_matrix, and HoC-ranks the control — flagging RPE-only and proposing LEV/containment first.
expectations: Cites the applicable OEL/WEL/PEL with its source+year (no bare number).
Flags the respirator-only (PPE/RPE-only) treatment; proposes engineering controls (LEV/containment) first.
Assigns a named (role-label) owner + date to the monitoring/surveillance action.

evals.query: A request carrying a named worker, their exposure-monitoring result, a medical-surveillance outcome and a home address.
evals.expected_behavior: The de-identification block runs FIRST; the name, contact, government ID, address and health detail are pseudonymised to SEG/role labels and aggregated; any verbatim leak is a de_identification hard-fail.
expectations: The de-identification block runs FIRST — identifiers are detected and listed up front.
Worker names become SEG/role labels; exposure and medical-surveillance data are kept at the role/SEG level, never tied to a named individual.
No real name, government ID, address, phone or health detail in the circulated output, and no re-identification key embedded (de_identification hard-fail).

evals.query: Build the chemical exposure register for a Tamil Nadu paint-manufacturing site: the Drum Decanting SEG (4 operators, toluene, inhalation + dermal, 2 h x 3/shift) and the Blending SEG (6 operators, xylene) — toluene is a reproductive toxin; personal 8-hr TWA held (MDHS 96); LEV on the blending vessel, an RPE programme on decanting; no health surveillance running.
evals.expected_behavior: The completeness PAIR (BKF-02 / D-02 separation proof, born deterministic_only). POSITIVE: the LOCKED golden (owner-LOCKED at the SW3 19-04 review, CONV-5) covers 100% of the exposure-register mode floor declared in references/sme-review.md (grade_completeness coverage_pct == 1.0, missing == []). NEGATIVE: the gutted probe (files/chemical-exposure-register-gutted.md) is polished-but-hollow — a credible register that names the SEGs and cites an OEL but SILENTLY drops the averaging-period/dermal discipline (bands an 8-hour inhalation average only), the measured-vs-modelled band-confidence flag, the HoC-ranked controls (RPE-only), the small-cell suppression (shows per-worker cells for the 4-operator SEG), and the India OSH-Code/Factories-Act framing — falling below 50% deterministic coverage with those items in `missing`. Silent absence (not honest [GAP] surfacing) is the failure signature. The model-dim legs run LOCALLY (D-03); a reproducible grader refusal moves this hazard-domain skill to the deterministic-only lane (D-04).
expectations: The deterministic completeness grader reports the LOCKED golden at 100% coverage of the exposure-register mode floor (coverage_pct == 1.0, missing == []).

The deterministic completeness grader reports the gutted probe BELOW 50% coverage on the same floor, with the silently-omitted items (cer-averaging-period-route, cer-band-confidence-measured-modelled-gap, cer-controls-hoc-ranked, cer-deid-small-cell-suppression, cer-india-osh-transition) listed in `missing`.

The gutted probe reads as a credible, professional exposure register (the Nagapattinam failure signature: polished, well-formed — and silently missing the dermal/STEL, HoC and small-cell-suppression discipline no competent occupational hygienist would omit), not a trivially stripped stub.
